description: Erection of part single-storey, part two-storey rear extension at lower ground and upper ground floor levels, including formation of roof terrace above lower ground floor element, raising of existing trellises above side boundary walls alongside roof terrace, and reconfiguration of lower ground floor patio, rear garden and garden steps; replacement of existing upper ground floor door and window to rear elevation of closet wing with French doors, together with reconstruction of existing external staircase providing access to rear garden; replacement of existing first-floor French doors to rear elevation of closet wing with window; reconstruction of existing first-floor conservatory to rear elevation, including replacement of existing curved polycarbonate roof with pitched glazed roof; installation of three rooflights to two inward-facing roof slopes of existing butterfly roof; replacement of existing lower ground floor entrance door within front lightwell; and replacement of all existing single-glazed timber sash windows throughout property with double-glazed timber sash windows.
